As we gain solidarity, we build courage.

Let's continue to build solidarity by peacefully opposing our tyrant-in-chief today at No Kings protests across the country.

Here’s what billionaires don’t want you to know.

A history of the top marginal tax rates on the wealthiest Americans: 

1940: 81%
1950: 84% 
1960: 91% 
1970: 72% 
1980: 70% 
1990: 28% 
2000: 40% 
2010: 35% 

For 50 years, corporate backed politicians in Congress have slashed taxes to line the pockets of their wealthy donors.

The cases declined include over 1,000 terrorism cases, nearly 5,000 federal drug law violations, and over 900 federal program fraud.

Trump’s DOJ is letting actual criminals off the hook — all to break up families and terrorize communities.

What do these corporations all have in common? 
 
-Lockheed Martin 
-Palantir 
-Microsoft 
-Amazon 
-Comcast 
-Google 
-Apple 
-Meta 
-HP 
-Nvidia 
-T-Mobile 
 
They all have lucrative government contracts — and they were all donors to Trump's $400M ballroom that's now on pause.

Pete Hegseth’s broker reportedly tried to make a multimillion-dollar investment in a fund of weapons stocks just weeks before Trump launched his war on Iran.

Remember when even the appearance of corruption was enough to trigger a resignation?

We must not become numb to this.

Architectural experts are now warning that Trump's rushed White House ballroom is riddled with serious design flaws.

That might not even matter to the billionaires financing the project  — as long as Trump gives them their kickbacks and political favors. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Nbf6BJzpk1E

Thanks to the Medicaid cuts in Trump's Big Ugly Bill, over 400 hospitals across the country are at high risk of closing or cutting essential services.

It's one of many reasons why Republicans have stopped talking about their signature legislative accomplishment.

When Midway Blitz ramped down late last year, federal officials asserted that they weren't done with the Trump admin's mass deportation campaign in Chicagoland.

Activity has yet to reach the heights of last fall, but true to their word, ICE never left.

My latest, for @southsideweekly.bsky.social:

$1 billion spent every day on this war while the death toll rises and Trump is backed into a corner.

Meanwhile, at home...

Gas prices are skyrocketing. Food is even more expensive. Mortgage rates are going up. Household debt is at a record high. The job market is drying up.

Are we great yet?

Complaints to the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau doubled in 2025.

But under Russ Vought's tenure heading the CFPB, the agency has been gutted.

It's now easier than ever for shady banks, lenders, and credit card companies to pick your pocket.

And it's all because of the Trump regime.

Trump's reckless decision making on Iran is causing huge swings in the markets.

But like anything with Trump, ask yourself who is getting rich when he acts erratically.

Trump's actions feel chaotic until you see who really comes out on top.

Oligarchy (noun):

A government of and by a few at the top, who exercise power for their own benefit. Their power and wealth increase as they make laws that favor themselves, manipulate financial markets, and create monopolies that put more wealth into their pockets.

Trans people just want the right to exist safely as their true selves, like everyone else. 

But they’ve become easy scapegoats for the conservative moment, which vilifies them and threatens to criminalize their very existence.

It's straight from the authoritarian playbook.
America's new "Golden Age"...

$1 billion spent every day on this war while the death toll rises and Trump is backed into a corner.

Meanwhile, at home...

Gas prices are skyrocketing. Food is even more expensive. Mortgage rates are going up. Household debt is at a record high. The job market is drying up.

Are we great yet?

The national average gas price is now over $4/gallon — the highest level in four years.

Big Oil, which spent almost $100 million backing Trump in 2024, could see a nearly $60B windfall from these price shocks.

Trump's buddies will make a killing while you pay the price at the pump.

This isn’t reality television. This is for real. And the reality is Americans are worse off now and less secure than we were when Trump started his war on Iran. Some thoughts... https://robertreich.substack.com/p/trumps-magical-thinking

Should corporations be able to weaponize your personal data to rip you off?

Well, they may already be doing that thanks to a shady tactic called “surveillance pricing.”

Former FTC Chair Lina Khan explains what we can do about it. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-cbtUYshYM8

Your tax season reminder that the real freeloaders in this country are the rich — not the poor or immigrants or any other group of people vilified as scapegoats. The richest 1% evade $160 billion in taxes every year. The United States literally has yacht and private jet tax deductions. Hello?
The call is coming from inside the house.
